Interface CicsContext

public interface CicsContext
The CICS execution context — what a program sees during a transaction.

Analogous to HttpServletRequest + HttpServletResponse + transaction manager combined into a single handle. Every EXEC CICS command in COBOL maps to a method on this interface.

Programs never manage resources directly — they ask the context, and the context delegates to the region's managed resource pools. 

CicsProgram inquiry = (ctx) -> {
    ctx.receive(commarea);
    String custId = commarea.getString("CUST-ID").trim();

    ctx.readFile("CUSTFILE", custRec, custId);
    commarea.move("CUST-NAME", custRec.getString("NAME"));
    commarea.move("CUST-BAL", custRec.getDecimal("BALANCE"));

    ctx.send(commarea);
    ctx.returnTransaction();
};

  • Method Details

    • receive

      void receive(Record commarea)
      EXEC CICS RECEIVE — read the incoming COMMAREA into a Record. In a conversational transaction, this waits for terminal input.

    • send

      void send(Record commarea)
      EXEC CICS SEND — write the COMMAREA back to the caller.

    • commarea

      byte[] commarea()
      Get the raw COMMAREA bytes that initiated this transaction.

    • returnTransaction

      void returnTransaction()
      EXEC CICS RETURN — end this program's execution. The COMMAREA is returned to the caller.

    • returnTransaction

      void returnTransaction(String nextTransactionId)
      EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID(xxxx) — end this program but schedule another transaction to run next (pseudo-conversational pattern).

    • readFile

      boolean readFile(String fileName, Record record, String key)
      EXEC CICS READ FILE(name) INTO(record) RIDFLD(key). Reads a record from a region-managed file by key.
      Returns:
      true if found, false if NOTFND condition

    • writeFile

      void writeFile(String fileName, Record record)
      EXEC CICS WRITE FILE(name) FROM(record).

    • rewriteFile

      void rewriteFile(String fileName, Record record)
      EXEC CICS REWRITE FILE(name) FROM(record). Updates the last-read record.

    • deleteFile

      void deleteFile(String fileName, String key)
      EXEC CICS DELETE FILE(name) RIDFLD(key).

    • writeTS

      int writeTS(String queueName, Record record)
      EXEC CICS WRITEQ TS QUEUE(name) FROM(record). Appends a record to a TS queue. Returns the item number.

    • readTS

      boolean readTS(String queueName, Record record, int item)
      EXEC CICS READQ TS QUEUE(name) INTO(record) ITEM(n). Reads item N from a TS queue (1-based).
      Returns:
      true if the item exists

    • readTSNext

      boolean readTSNext(String queueName, Record record)
      EXEC CICS READQ TS QUEUE(name) INTO(record) NEXT. Reads the next sequential item.
      Returns:
      true if there was a next item

    • deleteTS

      void deleteTS(String queueName)
      EXEC CICS DELETEQ TS QUEUE(name). Deletes an entire TS queue.

    • tsQueueDepth

      int tsQueueDepth(String queueName)
      Get the number of items in a TS queue.

    • link

      void link(String programName, Record commarea)
      EXEC CICS LINK PROGRAM(name) COMMAREA(data). Calls a sub-program with a COMMAREA. Control returns here when the linked program finishes. Like a subroutine call.

    • link

      void link(String programName)
      EXEC CICS LINK PROGRAM(name). Link without a COMMAREA.

    • xctl

      void xctl(String programName, Record commarea)
      EXEC CICS XCTL PROGRAM(name) COMMAREA(data). Transfer control to another program — this program does NOT get control back. Like a goto to another handler.

    • xctl

      void xctl(String programName)
      EXEC CICS XCTL PROGRAM(name). Transfer without COMMAREA.
